headline: Restarts Wi-Fi, but line 9 also deletes every saved network.
summary: Restarts NetworkManager and reloads the iwlwifi driver with power saving off until reboot, as the reason says. Line 9 also deletes every saved Wi-Fi network, which the reason doesn't mention.
notes: Line 9 deletes every saved Wi-Fi network and its password, which the reason doesn't mention.
not_shown: Whether iwlwifi is the driver in use here.
